name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet approximately shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees, lowering within a comfortable range.
Press through your feet to return to standing.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips while keeping your ribs controlled.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs and a slight knee bend.
Move your hips back, keeping the weights close to your legs.
Return to standing with controlled movement.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on a stable raised surface.
Bend your elbows while maintaining a straight body position.
Press back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support yourself on a stable bench and hold a dumbbell.
Draw your elbow back without twisting your torso.
Lower the weight with control.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms raised and knees bent.
Slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg within a comfortable range.
Return and alternate sides while keeping your torso steady.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand upright with your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Return your feet together and lower your arms, landing softly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a high plank with your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and lower your body while keeping your torso steady.
Press through your hands to return to the starting position.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel and hold the wheel under your shoulders with arms straight.
Brace your core and roll forward slowly, keeping your back from sagging.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees using your abs, not your hips.

name: Active Hang
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back without bending your elbows.
Hold the engaged position, breathing steadily, then lower to a relaxed hang.

name: Archer Push-up
instructions: Set up in a wide push-up position with hands well beyond shoulder-width.
Lower toward one hand while the opposite arm stays nearly straight.
Press back to the top and alternate sides each repetition.

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand tall with arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw small controlled circles, gradually making them larger.
Reverse the direction after the set time or repetitions.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at chin height, palms facing you.
Press overhead while rotating your palms to face forward.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

name: Assault Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Push and pull the handles while driving the pedals at a steady rhythm.
Increase effort for intervals and ease off to recover.

name: Assisted Chin-up
instructions: Set the assistance band or machine and grip the bar with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly to a full hang under control.

name: Assisted Dip
instructions: Set the assistance and grip the dip handles with arms straight.
Lower by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms without shrugging.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a support in front of you.
Sit back and down on the standing leg, extending the other leg forward.
Use the support lightly as you drive back up to standing.

name: Assisted Pull-up
instructions: Set the assistance and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width, palms forward.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad at your hips and anchor your feet on the bench.
Lower your torso forward with a neutral spine.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line, squeezing your glutes.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with straight arms.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Banded Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with a band above your knees and knees bent.
Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee against the band.
Pause briefly and lower with control.

name: Banded Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back holding a band anchored behind you, arms extended up.
Lower one leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back pressed down.
Return the leg and alternate sides while resisting the band.

name: Banded Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band looped around your feet or thighs.
Drive one heel up toward the ceiling, keeping the knee bent.
Lower with control without arching your lower back.

name: Banded Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a band at face height and hold an end in each hand.
Pull toward your face, spreading your hands and lifting your elbows high.
Pause with shoulder blades squeezed, then return slowly.

name: Banded Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band above your knees.
Lift one knee out to the side while keeping your hips level.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Banded Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and the soles of your feet together.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Press your knees out slightly and lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Banded Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a band above your knees.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Keep knees pressed out against the band as you lower.

name: Banded Kickback
instructions: Anchor a band low and loop it around one ankle, holding a support.
Extend the leg straight back, squeezing your glute.
Return slowly without leaning your torso forward.

name: Banded Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel holding an end in each hand.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides.
Return your arms overhead slowly.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: Place a band above your knees or ankles and sit into a half squat.
Step sideways while keeping tension in the band.
Take equal steps in both directions.

name: Banded Monster Walk
instructions: Place a band around your ankles and bend your knees slightly.
Walk forward and diagonally with wide steps.
Keep constant tension and avoid letting your knees cave in.

name: Banded Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press your hands straight out from your chest, resisting rotation.
Hold briefly, bring your hands back, and repeat.

name: Banded Row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Pull your elbows back past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.

name: Banded Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit on a bench with a band above your knees.
Push your knees outward against the band.
Return slowly while keeping tension.

name: Banded Squat
instructions: Stand on a band holding the ends at your shoulders.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand with a band around your ankles and hold a support.
Lift one leg out to the side, keeping your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

name: Banded Woodchop
instructions: Anchor a band high and hold it with both hands beside one shoulder.
Pull diagonally across your body toward the opposite hip, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back.
Squat down, keeping your chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace and stand up by driving your feet into the floor, keeping the bar close.
Lower the bar by hinging at your hips, then bending your knees.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a padded barbell across your hips and feet flat.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower with control.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs.
Hinge at your hips with a slight knee bend, keeping the bar close.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower the bar slowly to arm's length.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Lower slowly.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand with knees slightly bent.
Make waves by moving your arms quickly up and down.
Keep your core braced and maintain a steady rhythm.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on hands and feet with knees hovering just above the floor.
Move forward by stepping opposite hand and foot together.
Keep your back flat and hips low throughout.

name: Bear Plank
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, with a flat back.

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Squat down by bending your hips and knees.
Drive up through your feet to return to standing.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Place your hands on a bench behind you with legs extended forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders.

name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Hinge forward holding light dumbbells with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows still.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and knees lifted.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate sides in a controlled pedaling motion.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold briefly, return, and alternate sides.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and rest your rear foot on it.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank, then jump them back in.
Explode upward into a jump and land softly.

name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees out to the sides.
Hold your feet and sit up tall.
Gently lower your knees toward the floor and hold.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch down by flexing your spine, bringing elbows toward your thighs.
Return slowly without letting your hips move.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable holding the bar with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Stand between two high cables holding a handle in each hand.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable holding the handle.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and face the machine.
Kick your leg straight back, squeezing your glute.
Return slowly without arching your lower back.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle with your far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Cable Pallof Hold
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height.
Press the handle straight out in front of your chest.
Hold the position, resisting rotation, then switch sides.

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Face away from a low cable holding a rope between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, letting the rope pull back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Stand between two cables at shoulder height, holding opposite handles.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Return slowly with control.

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach an ankle strap and stand side-on to a low cable.
Lift your outside leg away from your body.
Return slowly without leaning.

name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to your inside leg, standing side-on to the cable.
Pull your leg across in front of your body.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Stand side-on to a high cable holding the handle with both hands.
Pull diagonally down across your body, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly to the start position.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or the floor.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
instructions: Support yourself on the forearm pads with your back against the pad.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Arch your back and lift your head, then round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between positions with your breath.

name: Chair Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair with hands beside your hips.
Slide forward and lower by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with a slight forward lean.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up while keeping the forward lean.

name: Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Pull the weights toward your lower ribs.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward along the floor.
Relax your forehead down and breathe deeply.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Lift your top knee while keeping your feet touching.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown machine holding a close-grip handle.
Pull the handle to your upper chest.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

name: Commando Pull-up
instructions: Grip the bar with hands close together, one in front of the other.
Pull your head to one side of the bar.
Lower and alternate sides each repetition.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit with your elbow braced against your inner thigh, holding a dumbbell.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position, then switch sides.

name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Push back to the center and alternate sides.

name: Crab Walk
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Walk forward or backward on your hands and feet.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use the other hand to gently press it closer.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly by your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor using your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a lunge.
Return to standing and alternate sides.

name: Cycling
instructions: Adjust the saddle so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Pedal at a steady, comfortable cadence.
Adjust resistance to control the intensity.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a bar with both hands, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with your arms straight and body relaxed.
Hold for time, then step down carefully.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press back up over your shoulders.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to your chest.

name: Decline Push-up
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back.
Sit up by curling your torso toward your knees.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on a low platform with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back off the platform and lower into a lunge.
Drive through your front foot to return and alternate sides.

name: Diamond Push-up
instructions: Place your hands close together under your chest, forming a diamond shape.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the top.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Hinge forward with your hands on a support and the balls of your feet on a step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Drive one heel up toward the ceiling with your knee bent.
Lower with control and alternate sides.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
instructions: Place your forearms on either side of a doorway.
Step forward gently until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold and breathe steadily.

name: Doorway Row
instructions: Hold both sides of a sturdy doorframe and lean back with straight arms.
Pull your chest toward the doorframe.
Lower back slowly.

name: Drag Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the bar up while dragging it along your body, moving your elbows back.
Lower slowly along the same path.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your body until only your upper back touches the bench.
Lower your straight body slowly toward the bench.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to chest level.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward holding dumbbells with a flat back.
Pull the weights toward your lower ribs.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a lunge.
Return to standing and alternate sides.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Bring the weights back together over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive through your heels until your torso is level.
Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Push back to the center and alternate sides.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back overhead.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them overhead.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend sideways toward the weight.
Return upright using your obliques.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs.
Hinge and bend your knees to lower the weight.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with a wide stance holding a dumbbell at your chest or between your legs.
Squat down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Push and pull in a smooth, steady motion.
Adjust resistance to control intensity.

name: Explosive Push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, then press up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows and repeat.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows still.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope on a cable at face height.
Pull the rope toward your face, spreading your hands apart.
Return slowly with control.

name: Farmer Carry
instructions: Hold heavy weights at your sides.
Walk forward with an upright posture and braced core.
Keep your shoulders level throughout.

name: Fast Feet
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Run in place with quick, short steps on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and arms moving.

name: Feet-Elevated Pike Push-up
instructions: Place your feet on a box with hips high and hands on the floor.
Lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up.

name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee out to the side while keeping your hips level.
Lower slowly and alternate sides.

name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and slightly raised.
Alternate small up-and-down kicks.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Lower with control.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Squat down while keeping your torso upright.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Place your front foot on a low platform in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through your front foot to rise.

name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lift into a glute bridge position.
Raise one knee toward your chest while keeping your hips level.
Lower it and alternate legs.

name: Glute-Focused Back Extension
instructions: Set up on a back extension bench with your upper back slightly rounded.
Lower your torso forward.
Raise up by squeezing your glutes, keeping your toes turned out.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at your chest.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Rest a bar across your upper back.
Hinge at your hips with a slight knee bend until your torso is near parallel.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Lower by bending your knees.
Press back up through your feet.

name: Half Burpee
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step or jump your feet back to a plank, then back in.
Stand up tall.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee side-on to a cable at chest height.
Press the handle straight out from your chest.
Resist rotation, return, and repeat.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly.

name: Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Extend one leg forward with your heel on the floor or a low step.
Hinge forward from your hips with a straight back.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Handstand Push-up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise your straight legs to hip height or higher.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Heel Tap
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly and reach side to side to tap your heels.
Keep your core engaged throughout.

name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate, holding a weight at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso upright.
Stand back up.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.

name: Hiking
instructions: Choose a trail suited to your fitness level.
Walk with an upright posture, shortening your stride on inclines.
Keep a steady pace you can sustain.

name: Hindu Push-up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high.
Swoop your chest down and forward, then up into an upward dog.
Reverse the motion to return.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees outward.
Return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with pads on the inside of your knees.
Squeeze your knees together.
Return slowly.

name: Hip Airplane
instructions: Stand on one leg and hinge forward.
Rotate your hips open, then closed, while balancing.
Move slowly and switch legs.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a barbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until level.
Lower with control.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor, pressing your lower back down.
Hold the position.

name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Get into a hollow body position.
Rock back and forth while keeping the shape.
Maintain tension throughout.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a plank.
Walk your feet toward your hands and stand up.

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press back up.

name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Set a bench on an incline between low cables.
Bring the handles together over your upper chest in an arc.
Return slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells at your sides.
Curl the weights up while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights up.
Lower slowly.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Lie under a bar set at waist height and grip it.
Pull your chest to the bar while keeping your body straight.
Lower slowly.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the handles with elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists and jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then jump explosively.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips with a slight knee bend.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge and hike the kettlebell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again.

name: Knee Push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position on your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Shift your hips forward gently, keeping your torso upright.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: L-Sit Hold
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or the floor with straight arms.
Lift your straight legs until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold the position.

name: L-Sit Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar and lift your legs to an L-position.
Pull up while keeping your legs raised.
Lower slowly.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height.
Press the bar up and forward.
Lower slowly.

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Straddle a landmine bar and hold the end with both hands.
Hinge at your hips with a slight knee bend.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Squat down.
Drive back up.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the machine and grip the bar wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Return slowly.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Push back to the center.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Get into an athletic stance with knees bent.
Shuffle sideways quickly without crossing your feet.
Change direction and repeat.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Set up on the leg curl machine with the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Return slowly.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Extend your knees to straighten your legs.
Lower slowly.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the platform by bending your knees.
Press back up without locking your knees.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Place the balls of your feet at the bottom edge of the leg press platform.
Push through your toes to extend your ankles.
Lower slowly.

name: Leg Swings
instructions: Hold a support and stand on one leg.
Swing the other leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Switch legs after the set.

name: Lying Hamstring Walkout
instructions: Lift into a glute bridge position.
Walk your heels out a few steps, then walk them back.
Keep your hips lifted.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lower slowly without arching your lower back.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit with the handles at chest height.
Press the handles forward.
Return slowly.

name: Machine Glute Kickback
instructions: Set up on the machine with one foot on the platform.
Push your leg back and up.
Return slowly.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit in the machine with pads against your arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Return slowly.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit with the handles at shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower slowly.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand side-on to a landmine bar and grip the end with one hand.
Row the bar toward your hip.
Lower slowly.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a plank position.
Drive your knees toward your chest one at a time.
Keep a quick, steady pace with hips level.

name: Negative Pull-up
instructions: Start at the top of a pull-up position.
Lower yourself slowly over 3 to 5 seconds.
Step back up and repeat.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-up
instructions: Grip parallel handles with palms facing each other.
Pull your chin above the handles.
Lower slowly.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored.
Lower your torso forward slowly, keeping your hips straight.
Push lightly off the floor to return.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders.
Press it overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a weight overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head.
Extend your arms.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height.
Press the handle straight out.
Resist rotation and return.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Sit with your arms on the pads.
Bring the pads together in front of your chest.
Return slowly.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Hinge until your torso is parallel to the floor, bar on the ground.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor each repetition.

name: Pike Push-up
instructions: Get into a pike position with hips high and hands on the floor.
Lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Squat down on the standing leg.
Stand back up without support.

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Plank Jack
instructions: Start in a plank position.
Jump your feet out and in.
Keep your hips level.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.
Alternate sides while keeping your hips steady.

name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your thighs.
Raise it forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit with your arms resting on the preacher pad.
Curl the weight up.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y shape.
Lift your arms off the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your chin above the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Push Press
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders.
Dip slightly, then drive with your legs to press the bar overhead.
Lower to your shoulders.

name: Push-up Shoulder Tap
instructions: Do a push-up.
At the top, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand.
Repeat, keeping your hips steady.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at knee height.
Grip it and stand tall by driving your hips forward.
Lower back to the pins under control.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and lifted.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Curl the weight up.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall.
Step back and lower into a lunge.
Return to standing and alternate legs.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the machine and grip the handles.
Pull your arms back in a wide arc.
Return slowly.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
instructions: Lie face down with your arms at your sides.
Sweep your arms overhead in an arc while keeping them lifted.
Return slowly.

name: Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold a rope on a low cable.
Curl the rope up with palms facing each other.
Lower slowly.

name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Hold a rope on a high cable with elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope apart.
Return slowly.

name: Rowing
instructions: Strap your feet in and grip the handle.
Drive with your legs, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms, torso, then legs.

name: Running
instructions: Run with an upright posture and relaxed shoulders.
Land lightly under your hips.
Keep a pace you can sustain.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Rotate your torso side to side.
Keep your chest lifted.

name: Scapular Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Relax back to a hang.

name: Scapular Push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades, then push the floor away.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

name: Seal Jack
instructions: Stand with your arms extended in front of you.
Jump your feet out while opening your arms wide.
Jump back in while clapping your hands together.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with feet braced.
Pull the handle to your torso.
Return slowly.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the pad on your knees and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Raise your heels.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Sit with your legs extended.
Hinge forward from your hips.
Hold the stretch.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and lean back slightly.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad behind your ankles.
Curl your legs down.
Return slowly.

name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold your other foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stand back up.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
instructions: Get into a side plank.
Lower your hip toward the floor.
Lift it back up.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with legs straight.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Raise your top leg.
Lower slowly.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead with one hand.
Lower it behind your head.
Extend your arm.

name: Single Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Lower it toward your forehead.
Extend your arms.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Stand or sit facing a cable and grip one handle.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Return slowly.

name: Single-Leg Box Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of a box.
Sit back to touch the box.
Stand back up.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step.
Raise your heel.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg extended.
Lift your hips.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a weight.
Hinge forward as your free leg extends back.
Return to standing.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand holding a support.
Lean back and bend your knees forward.
Return to standing.

name: Skater Hop
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Leap sideways onto the other foot.
Repeat side to side.

name: Skater Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stand back up.

name: SkiErg
instructions: Stand facing the machine holding the handles overhead.
Pull down by hinging at your hips and bending your knees.
Return to the start.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Lie under the Smith machine bar.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench under the Smith machine bar.
Lower into a split squat.
Drive back up.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up with the Smith machine bar across your hips.
Thrust your hips up.
Lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand under the Smith machine bar.
Step back into a lunge.
Return to standing.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the Smith machine bar at your thighs.
Hinge at your hips.
Stand up.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
instructions: Set up in a split stance under the Smith machine bar.
Lower your back knee.
Drive back up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Stand under the Smith machine bar.
Squat down.
Drive back up.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your arms hanging.
Curl the weights up.
Lower slowly.

name: Split Squat
instructions: Stand in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive back up.

name: Sprawl
instructions: From standing, drop your hands to the floor.
Shoot your legs back and let your hips drop toward the floor.
Jump your feet in and stand up.

name: Squat Thrust
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Jump your feet in and stand up.

name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips and curl the ball toward you.
Extend your legs again.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the rails lightly.
Climb at a steady pace.
Keep an upright posture.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a platform.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Dumbbell Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Pull your other heel toward your glute.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Step-Down
instructions: Stand on a step.
Lower one foot slowly toward the floor.
Return to the top.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto a box with one foot.
Drive up to stand on the box.
Step back down.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with arms extended.
Pull the bar down to your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Return slowly.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance and grip the bar inside your knees.
Stand up by driving through your feet.
Lower slowly.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your arms and legs off the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down.
Lift your arms and legs.
Hold the position.

name: Swimming
instructions: Choose a stroke you are comfortable with.
Swim at a steady, controlled pace.
Breathe rhythmically.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the T-bar and grip the handles.
Row the bar toward your chest.
Lower slowly.

name: Toe Touch
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised vertically.
Reach up toward your toes.
Lower slowly.

name: Torso Twists
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Towel Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips and slide your heels toward you.
Slide them back out.

name: Towel Pull-up
instructions: Drape towels over a bar and grip them.
Pull yourself up.
Lower slowly.

name: Towel Row
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy post and lean back holding both ends.
Pull yourself toward the post.
Lower back slowly.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar and grip the handles.
Stand up by driving through your feet.
Lower the bar slowly.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
instructions: Set the treadmill to an incline.
Walk at a steady pace.
Avoid holding the rails if possible.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward holding a dumbbell with your elbow bent.
Extend your arm back.
Return slowly.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Hold a bar on a high cable with elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

name: Two Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Extend your arms back up.

name: Typewriter Push-up
instructions: Start in a wide push-up position.
Lower down, shift side to side, then press up.
Repeat.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold a bar at your thighs.
Pull it up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your legs and torso to meet in the middle.
Lower slowly.

name: Walking
instructions: Walk with an upright posture.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep a brisk, steady pace.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge.
Bring your back foot forward into the next lunge.
Continue walking forward.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Place your hands on a wall with one leg back.
Press your back heel into the floor.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Wall Handstand Push-up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Wall Push-up
instructions: Place your hands on a wall at chest height.
Lower your chest toward the wall.
Push back.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean your back against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Hold the position.

name: Wall Walk
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet against a wall.
Walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk closer.
Walk back down.

name: Weighted Chin-up
instructions: Attach a weight belt and hang from a bar, palms facing you.
Pull your chin above the bar.
Lower slowly.

name: Weighted Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back holding a weight on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Weighted Dip
instructions: Attach a weight belt and support yourself on parallel bars.
Lower down.
Press back up.

name: Weighted Pull-up
instructions: Attach a weight belt and hang from a bar.
Pull your chin above the bar.
Lower slowly.

name: Weighted Push-up
instructions: Place a weight plate on your upper back.
Do a push-up.
Repeat.

name: Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit holding a weight with your knees bent.
Rotate side to side.
Keep your chest lifted.

name: Wide Push-up
instructions: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your chest.
Press back up.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wide.
Pull it to your upper chest.
Return slowly.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a deep lunge.
Place your inside hand down and rotate your other arm toward the ceiling.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Curl the weight up with your wrists.
Lower slowly.

name: Wrist Extension
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Lift the weight with your wrists.
Lower slowly.
